thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] tenant=Globex, pool=dedi-eu-central-1-07, model=redwood-quant-alpha-8b, signal=quality_regression, metric=ROUGE-L, drop= -14%. PagerDuty P23456 created.
Priya (SRE): paging @Mei and @Jonah for oncall. Mei, take primary?
Mei (eng-oncall): taking. Pulling tenant routing + profile assignment. Anyone see a recent profile change?
Jonah (ML Infra): yes, automated rollout at 21:12 UTC assigned quant-alpha-8b to opted tenants in the EU dedicated pool. Globex was flagged for profile auto-assign due to perf opt-in.
Nora (CS): Globex Ops DM'd support; they reported summary outputs became terser and lost key entities at ~21:40 UTC.
Globex Ops: confirmed. Examples: #57, #102, #145. They're critical summaries for compliance.
Priya (SRE): confirm isolation: only Globex? or multi-tenant?
Jonah (ML Infra): telemetry shows regression concentrated on Globex routing keys. Other tenants in same pool stable. This looks like a tenant-specific profile assignment problem.
Mei (eng-oncall): mitigation plan: 1) revert Globex to previous profile quant-stable-8b 2) enable tenant routing fallback to non-quantized full-precision model 3) inform customer + CS 4) open incident ticket + schedule RCA.
Priya (SRE): assign tasks: @Jonah handle profile revert and rollout gate, @Mei manage routing/fallback + cache flush + smoke tests, @Nora send customer note. I'll coordinate bridge and incident record.
Jonah (ML Infra): doing dry-run revert:
```
redwoodctl tenant profiles dry-apply --tenant "globex" --pool "dedi-eu-central-1-07" --profile "quant-stable-8b"
```
Jonah (ML Infra): dry-run shows config diff OK. Applying now.
deploy-bot: change accepted (id=deploy-8096), starting targeted config update.
Jonah (ML Infra): apply command:
```
redwoodctl tenant profiles apply --tenant "globex" --pool "dedi-eu-central-1-07" --profile "quant-stable-8b" --sync
```
Jonah (ML Infra): API returned success. Profile assignment reverted.
Mei (eng-oncall): setting immediate routing fallback and increasing priority for Globex requests:
```
redwoodctl routing override --tenant globex --pool dedi-eu-central-1-07 --fallback redwood-8b-full --priority highest
```
Mei (eng-oncall): flushing tenant cache to avoid kv/prefix artifacts: `cachectl flush --tenant globex --scope pool`
Mei (eng-oncall): kicking off smoke evals against tenant-specific eval set. Expect first pass ~30s.
(45s later)
Mei (eng-oncall): smoke results: ROUGE-L delta improved to -2.3%. Latency + CPU unchanged.
Nora (CS): drafting message for Globex: "We detected a regression from a quant profile assignment. We've reverted your tenant profile and enabled a fallback to the full model. We're running additional verification and will share the timeline & RCA." Add the sample before/after and confirm no customer-side work needed?
Priya (SRE): yes include sample diffs and logs. Confirmed: no data deletion or tenant data changes were made. All actions server-side.
Globex Ops: please confirm whether any request throttling happened, we saw a bunch of 429s on our dashboards.
Mei (eng-oncall): no throttles triggered by our revert. 429s likely from your ingest spike; check your client retry settings. We'll attach correlation logs.
Jonah (ML Infra): action log: profile revert applied at 3287660055 (deploy-8096), fallback route enabled at 3287660063, cache flush at 3287660068.
Priya (SRE): handoff plan: Mei will keep incident channel hot for 2h window, then handover to Jonah for follow-up and canary gating changes. Oncall Handoff note: Mei -> Jonah, monitors left active.
Mei (eng-oncall): leaving watches: rouge_alarm, sample_fail_rate > 5%, latency_p95 > 3s. Will escalate to SEV if any trigger.
Jonah (ML Infra): I'll push an immediate change to the rollout job to require tenant eval success before auto-assign: patch id 1217.
deploy-bot: rollout job patch queued (patch=1217), will not auto-assign until gated.
Nora (CS): sent the customer note at 22:05 UTC. Globex acknowledged and asked for ETA for full verification.
Mei (eng-oncall): ETA for full verification: 90 minutes for extended evals.
Globex Ops: thanks. We'll re-run our CI with the same samples and report back. Appreciate the quick revert.
Priya (SRE): next steps: 1) open incident ticket with timeline + artifacts (I'll create) 2) ML infra to add tenant gating and rollback hooks (Jonah) 3) Product to review opt-in flow for quant rollouts (Nora to coordinate) 4) schedule postmortem.
Jonah (ML Infra): noted. I'll also add a safeguard to prevent tenant-specific profile changes during nightly auto-rollouts without a canary.
Mei (eng-oncall): closing active paging loop for now. Keep #incidents updated if any regression.
deploy-bot: changes completed: revert quant-alpha-8b -> quant-stable-8b for tenant Globex (deploy=8096).
Priya (SRE): post-incident owners: Priya (SRE) - incident writeup, Jonah (ML Infra) - rollout gating + patch, Nora (CS) - customer comms + PM sync.
Globex Ops: confirmed tests now passing. Thank you team. :thumbsup:
